summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Sentry RAG permission-aware assistant. All critical features verified including RBAC-filtered retrieval, admin console, user approval flow, and chat interface. Backend tests: 100% pass rate (15/15). Frontend tests: All major user stories validated. **CORE RBAC FEATURE CONFIRMED WORKING**: Same question asked by different roles returns different answers with different retrieval counts.

integration_issues.issue: JWT sessions expire quickly during extended testing, causing redirects to login page
integration_issues.impact: Minor - does not affect normal user flow, only impacts extended automated testing
